parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for fuzzy match by instance ID or instance name.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in a single request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page.

parameters.name: RelatedUserId
parameters.description: The account ID of the user who owns the instance. Used to filter instances by owner.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The DataWorks resource group identifier. You can specify a numeric resource group ID or a full identifier in the format of Serverless_res_group_{tenantId}_{resgId}.

parameters.name: SubType
parameters.description:
The instance subtype. Valid values:
- PERSONAL_DEV: personal development environment.
- DATA_AGENT: Data Agent.
